verdict.rationale: Granola documents automation-like features: recipes, templates, Zapier and HubSpot syncs, and auto-drafted follow-ups. Nothing in the evidence shows these automations can be versioned, have their changes reviewed, or be rolled back to an earlier state. The API changelog versions the vendor's API rather than user automations, the Chat review step approves a single action before it is sent, and note restore applies to deleted notes; all three are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
